identityMove.notice: Profiles, handles, ratings, consolidations and delegations move to the 6529 Network. From {freezeDay} {freezeTime} UTC you can't change them for about 24 hours. From {switchOnWeekday} you change them on the 6529 Network, through this site.
identityMove.frozen: Profiles, handles, ratings, consolidations and delegations are moving to the 6529 Network. You can't change them until {switchOnDay} {switchOnTime} UTC. From then you change them on the 6529 Network, through this site.
identityMove.moved: Profiles, handles, ratings, consolidations and delegations moved to the 6529 Network on {switchOnDay}. You can't change them on this site yet.
identityMove.paused: Paused for the move to the 6529 Network.
identityMove.nftDelegation.label: NFTDelegation and the 6529 Network
identityMove.nftDelegation.notice: From {freezeDay} {freezeTime} UTC, new delegations and consolidations on NFTDelegation don't count for 6529. Your delegations and consolidations as of that time moved to the 6529 Network. Make changes there, on this site.
identityMove.nextGenMint: NextGen mints still read delegations from NFTDelegation, not from the 6529 Network.
